text:
Maria: Heads-up: v1->v2 SDK migration notes — noticed a few broken snippets in the 'Streaming API' and 'Model parameter' sections. I'll open a PR but need a short checklist.

Dan: @Maria thanks — which snippets are failing? JS / Python / Go?

Maria: All three. Primary issues: 1) v1 used `models: ['redwood-v1']` arrays, v2 expects `model: 'redwood-v2'`. 2) Streaming callback signature changed from `on_chunk(chunk)` to `on_delta(delta)`; examples and tests still show the old name. 3) Several pages reference `/v1/` endpoints directly — need to swap to v2 examples or generic client calls.

Kevin: I can grep for `models:` and `on_chunk` and open a PR with automated fixes. Any required wording for the deprecation banner?

Maria: Suggested banner text: `Deprecated: v1 APIs will be removed on 2026-09-30. Migrate to v2. See migration guide: https://docs.redwood.com/migration/v1-to-v2`. Keep it short and add a link to the migration guide and the SDK migration notes.

Leo: For JS streaming the new pattern should be something like:
```js
const stream = await client.responses.stream({ model: 'redwood-2', input: 'hello' }, {
  on_delta(delta) { console.log(delta); },
  on_done() { console.log('done'); }
});
```
I'll add that example to the JS SDK page.

Sam: DocsBot created issue to track this. Can we also add an entry to the changelog noting the breaking callback change?

DocsBot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/901. Suggested reviewers: @Dan, @Kevin. Label: docs/migration. CI will run on any PR with that label.

Dan: I'll prepare a sed/grep script to update simple cases and open a WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432 (WIP). Planning to split commits by language: js, python, go.

Maria: PR checklist for me to review: 
- update codeblocks in docs/**/*.md and examples/* for JS/Python/Go
- replace `models: [...]` with `model: '...'` where appropriate (preserve arrays where lists are intended)
- update streaming examples to `on_delta` and adjust sample payloads
- add deprecation banner to v1 pages and note removal date
- update migration guide with concrete code diffs and a small 'quick fix' script
- add a changelog note and link to the PR
- assign reviewers and run snippet rendering tests

Kevin: Also update the "model map" page where we listed variants + fallback behavior. Add a short note about model swap fallback—v2 will automatically route to compatible quantized variant if exact match unavailable.

Maria: Can we get this merged by EOD tomorrow? If folks can't make that, ping me and we'll prioritize core pages first (Streaming, Quickstart, API reference).

Dan: On it. I'll aim for a draft PR tonight and push fixes tomorrow morning.

Leo: I'll handle Go samples and add a line to the SDK CHANGELOG explaining the callback rename.

Maria: Thanks all — once PR is up I'll post the final link in #docs and tag @product for visibility. :thumbsup:
